name: AISQ
summary: An autonomous marketing execution engine. Consolidates SEO, content distribution, and strategy into one automated workflow.
best_for: solo marketers who want low-cost, pay-as-you-go AI marketing assistance (SEO + content workflows) without a subscription
skip_if: you need a stable, enterprise-grade platform with predictable pricing and naming, or deep best-in-class SEO tooling
honest_knock: AISQ (the Squirrly family) evolves its pricing and product names often — the honest advice is to buy only what's currently priced in front of you, in small credit batches first, and judge output on YOUR niche keywords before committing to bundles. Marketing automation that promises to cut workload 90% still needs your strategy and editing; credits generate drafts, not customers.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month, Web Dev Kit $51.20 and Business $71.99
pricing.notes: (2026-08-30, read on plugin.squirrly.co/wordpress-seo-pricing) Squirrly SEO is billed monthly and renews at the same price. Free $0. PRO $9.99/month: 5 sites, 50 keyword researches, 100 audit suite pages, 0 SERP checker credits. Web Dev Kit $51.20/month: 10 sites, 300 researches, 300 audit pages, 2000 SERP credits. Business $71.99/month: 7 sites, 300 researches, 300 audit pages, 3000 SERP credits. Focus pages per account run 1 / 25 / 70 / 70. Extra SERP checker credits are $19.99 per 1,000 a month. No price is published for the AISQ Meteor agency offer: aisq.com/meteor/pricing and aisq.com/agencies/pricing both redirect to aisq.com/growth/pricing, which sells a done-for-you marketing service instead — $450 for 1 month, $1,235 for 3 months, $2,449 for 6 months, prices excluding VAT.

cost_traps.label: Usage-metered
cost_traps.evidence: PRO $9.99/month: 5 sites, 50 keyword researches, 100 audit suite pages, 0 SERP checker credits.

compare_with.name: Semrush or standalone AI writers
compare_with.why: the established suites — pricier but stabler; AISQ's edge is cheap non-expiring credits for dabblers
